rain_event.title: Rain Event
rain_event.default: Daily precipitation strictly greater than 0 mm.

limitation.title: Limitation
limitation.default: GFS fixed-lead forecasts compared with ERA5 gridded reanalysis, not plot observations. This does not measure the live best-match forecast blend, crop outcomes or alert skill. The source grids differ. Rain days require all 24 UTC hourly values in both series. The window ends six days before today to allow ERA5 publication.

limitation.title: Limitation
limitation.default: ERA5 gridded historical averages, not plot measurements or an official station normal. Same-calendar-day means require all expected years per variable; missing means stay null. February 29 has eight samples. UTC days differ from Indian midnight days. Average rainfall is not a rain probability or an irrigation requirement.

warning.title: Warning
warning.default: Unadjusted FAO estimate, not locally calibrated crop need or an irrigation dose. Gross rain is not effective rain; soil storage, runoff and irrigation are excluded.
